title: Multiplying and Dividing Decimals
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through multiplying and dividing decimals.
definition: Multiplying by 10, 100 or 1,000 moves digits to higher place values; dividing moves them to lower places. For a decimal times a whole number, multiply as integers then restore the decimal places. Divide decimals using place values and extend with zeros when needed.

formulas.description: Move digits n places higher for nonnegative integer n.

exercises.solution: Each digit moves one place higher.
Each digit moves two places higher.
